notes.content: The Department of World Languages and Literatures offers courses and/or degrees in the languages listed below: Chinese - Minor French - Bachelor of Arts, Minor. See the "French, BA" major for additional information. German - Minor Italian - Minor Japanese - Minor Spanish - Bachelor of Arts, Master of Arts. See the "Spanish, BA" major for additional information. Coursework is also available in the following languages: Arabic, Korean, and Punjabi. For additional information, please visit: Department of World Languages & Literatures .
